learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to change a word from 'One' (Singular) to 'Many' (Plural) by adding 's'.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 I have ONE sweet candy 🍬. Oh wow, now my friend gave me THREE more! Now I have MANY candies 🍬🍬🍬! Let's learn how words change when things become MANY.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When there is only one person, animal, place, or thing, we call it 'One' or Singular. It stands alone like a brave hero!
When there are two, three, or more of the same thing, we call it 'Many' or Plural. They are in a group!
How do we make 'One' into 'Many'? We just use the magic letter 's'! We add 's' at the end of most naming words.
If a word ends in s, sh, ch, or x, we use a stronger magic! We add 'es' to make it many.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ If there is one 'Box', what do we say for three?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Is the word 'Apples' One or Many?
subjective_practice.hint: Look at the 's' at the end!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add 'es' to make this word Many: Glass -> ____
subjective_practice.hint: Write Glass and put 'es' right after it.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 My Magic 'S' Poster
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Draw one flower on the left side of a paper and write 'Flower'. Draw three flowers on the right side and write 'Flowers'. Highlight the 's' with a red crayon!

chapter_summary: ⭐ 'One' means a single thing. 'Many' means more than one.
⭐ We add 's' to most words to show 'Many' (Cat -> Cats).
⭐ We add 'es' to words ending in s, sh, ch, x (Box -> Boxes).
